comment: host mode: leave roles empty to delegate all LLM work to the host agent (claude -p / codex). This file makes direct-API mode available when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set. In Claude Code environments prefer --host claude (zero extra key, real cost accounting via total_cost_usd). REVIEW-PANEL INDEPENDENCE: the shipped defaults map the review, adjudication and grading roles to the SAME backend+model (anthropic / claude-opus-4-8), so the S20/S21 review panel is homogeneous_degraded: three bias-lens samples of one model, and the chair adjudicates its own disagreement. This is mechanically detected and disclosed in REVIEW_PANEL.json as panel_independence.status='homogeneous_degraded' plus a top-level independence_warning, never silently hidden. For a genuinely heterogeneous panel, point roles.review and roles.adjudication at DISTINCT backend/model pairs (for example review -> anthropic/claude-opus-4-8, adjudication -> openai/<model>); the panel then reports status='heterogeneous' with distinct_models >= 2. Host mode (no usable key) is reported as status='host_mode'.
